name: GHS Babi Khel — Government High School
description: AI agent catalog for Government High School Babi Khel, District Mohmand, Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, Pakistan. Lists every machine-readable resource and live endpoint so agents can use the site without running JavaScript. All endpoints are public, GET-only and CORS-open; every dynamic fact is read live from the school database (edge cache at most 5 minutes).

resources.name: AI Data Feed
resources.description: Complete live JSON snapshot: school profile, admission status/fee/dates/classes & seats/merit lists, results info and live grading scale, school merit lists, roll-slip sessions, notices, teachers and the live FAQ. Edge-cached at most 5 minutes.

resources.name: Live FAQ
resources.description: FAQ generated at request time from the school database (nothing hard-coded). Same text as the /faq page and its FAQPage JSON-LD.

resources.name: LLMs Full Text
resources.description: The whole site as one plain-text document: live facts, full FAQ answers, notices and staff.

resources.name: Markdown pages
resources.description: Every public page as clean Markdown: append .md (about, contact, admission, notices, results, merit-list, roll-no-slip, duties, teachers, faq, index.md for home, notices/<id>.md) or send Accept: text/markdown.

resources.name: OpenAPI description
resources.description: OpenAPI 3.1 description of the public machine endpoints.

resources.name: LLMs Guide
resources.description: Plain-text guide (llmstxt.org format) written for large language models. Summarises the school's mission, the public pages available, and the data an AI assistant can retrieve, so models can ground answers in authoritative school facts.

resources.name: Sitemap
resources.description: XML sitemap listing every public page URL with live last-modified dates. Drives search-engine and AI crawler discovery.

resources.name: RSS Feed
resources.description: RSS 2.0 feed of the latest school notices, for feed readers and automated monitoring.

resources.name: Robots
resources.description: robots.txt controlling crawler access, including AI and search bots.

resources.name: Humans
resources.description: humans.txt listing the people behind the site.

tools.name: AI Assistant Chat
tools.description: Streaming chat endpoint backed by a GLM model with school-grounded context. Accepts a conversation message history and returns server-sent-event token stream. Use for answering natural-language questions about the school.
tools.responseFormat: SSE frames: data: {"token":"…"} repeated, then data: {"done":true} or data: {"error":"…"}
